title: EWMA variance series seeded with the first squared return
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T] (decimal), lambda; text says seed with first observation. DITANYAKAN: EWMA variance/vol series and next-day forecast. RUMUS: card Core 1, V1(b), V2(a): s2_1 = r_1^2 (or s2_2 = r_1^2 in forecast indexing, as stated); s2_{t+1} = lambda s2_t + (1-lambda) r_t^2; no demeaning; toolkit ewma_variance(r, lam, init=...), ewma_sigma_series(init='first'). JAWAB: 1) returns from prices. 2) seed. 3) recursion. 4) sigma = sqrt. 5) forecast after r_T. 6) check positive.

title: EWMA variance seeded with sample variance of an initial block
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], lambda, initial block length m. DITANYAKAN: EWMA series starting after the seed block. RUMUS: card V1(a): s2_m = var(r[0:m]) (ddof per text, zero-mean mean(r^2) if stated); recurse from r_m; toolkit ewma_sigma_series(init='window', init_window=m). JAWAB: 1) seed. 2) recursion from index m. 3) output dates t > m (state alignment). 4) forecast.

title: EWMA with full-sample variance seed
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], lambda; text says initialise at sample variance. DITANYAKAN: EWMA series. RUMUS: card V1(c): s2_0 = var(r) over full sample; recursion from r_1 (note mild look-ahead in seed only). JAWAB: 1) seed. 2) recurse. 3) compare with other seeds (difference decays as lambda^t).

title: EWMA finite-window weights form
frame: DIKETAHUI: last n returns, lambda. DITANYAKAN: EWMA variance from normalised finite-window weights. RUMUS: card Core 1: weights (1-lambda) lambda^{i-1}/(1-lambda^n), i = 1 newest; s2 = sum w_i r_i^2. JAWAB: 1) order newest first. 2) weights sum 1. 3) weighted mean of squares. 4) compare with recursion.

title: Estimate EWMA lambda by maximum likelihood
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], lambda grid or bounds, seed rule. DITANYAKAN: lambda maximising Gaussian LL. RUMUS: card Core 4 with s2_t from EWMA: LL(lambda) = -0.5 sum [ln 2pi + ln s2_t + r_t^2/s2_t] over t after burn-in; maximise by grid or bounded scalar minimise. JAWAB: 1) fix seed and burn-in. 2) LL per lambda. 3) argmax. 4) report LL.
pitfalls: including the seed day in LL

title: Estimate EWMA lambda by RMSE against squared returns
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], lambda grid. DITANYAKAN: lambda minimising RMSE of s2_t versus r_t^2. RUMUS: RiskMetrics 1996: RMSE(lambda) = sqrt(mean((r_t^2 - s2_t)^2)), s2_t forecast from data before t. JAWAB: 1) grid. 2) RMSE. 3) argmin.

title: EWMA covariance matrix as of the last date
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns R [T x N], lambda, seed rule. DITANYAKAN: current EWMA covariance (and correlation). RUMUS: card Core 1: S_t = lambda S_{t-1} + (1-lambda) np.outer(r_t, r_t), including r_T for 'current'; corr = D^-1 S D^-1. JAWAB: 1) seed (initial block cov or outer(r_1,r_1)). 2) recursion through r_T. 3) symmetry and PSD check. 4) correlation unit diagonal.
pitfalls: np.dot(r, r) scalar instead of outer

title: EWMA correlation time series for an asset pair
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r1, r2 [T], lambda. DITANYAKAN: EWMA correlation series. RUMUS: card Core 1: s11, s22, s12 recursions with the same lambda; rho_t = s12/sqrt(s11 s22). JAWAB: 1) three recursions. 2) ratio. 3) check |rho| <= 1.
pitfalls: different lambdas per element break PSD

title: Annualised EWMA volatility
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily returns, lambda. DITANYAKAN: annualised current vol. RUMUS: card Core 9: annual variance = 252 daily variance; vol = sqrt(252) daily vol (365 crypto, 52 weekly, 12 monthly); toolkit ewma_vol, annualized_vol. JAWAB: 1) daily EWMA vol. 2) multiply by sqrt(periods). 3) report both.

title: GARCH(1,1) maximum likelihood fit (own optimiser)
deliverables: summary json: omega, alpha, beta, loglik, persistence
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T] (decimal), mean convention. DITANYAKAN: GARCH parameters and LL. RUMUS: card Core 2, 4: e_t = r_t - mu; s2_1 = sample var (or backcast); s2_t = omega + alpha e_{t-1}^2 + beta s2_{t-1}; maximise LL subject to omega > 0, alpha, beta >= 0, alpha+beta < 1; toolkit fit_garch11(r). JAWAB: 1) scale (percent) for optimiser stability, map back. 2) minimise -LL (L-BFGS-B / SLSQP). 3) report params, LL. 4) check constraints.
pitfalls: optimiser stuck at start values on decimal returns

title: GARCH(1,1) with arch package and percent rescaling
deliverables: summary json: omega_dec, alpha, beta, loglik_dec
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T] (decimal); text names arch or default library behaviour. DITANYAKAN: parameters in decimal units, sigma series, forecast. RUMUS: card Conventions: arch_model(100 r, mean='Constant' default or 'Zero', vol='GARCH', p=1, q=1).fit(disp='off'); omega_dec = omega/1e4; sigma_dec = sigma/100; LL_dec = LL_pct + T ln 100. JAWAB: 1) fit on percent. 2) map back. 3) conditional_volatility/100. 4) forecast(horizon=1).variance.iloc[-1]/1e4.
pitfalls: mean='Constant' default when the text says zero mean

title: GARCH with variance targeting
deliverables: summary json: v_l, omega, alpha, beta, loglik
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T]. DITANYAKAN: GARCH with omega = V_L(1-alpha-beta), V_L = sample variance. RUMUS: card Completing: fix V_L = var(r); optimise alpha, beta only; omega implied. JAWAB: 1) V_L. 2) LL over (alpha, beta). 3) omega. 4) compare to unconstrained.

title: GARCH persistence, long-run variance and half-life
deliverables: summary json: persistence, v_l, long_run_vol_annual, half_life
frame: DIKETAHUI: omega, alpha, beta (daily). DITANYAKAN: P, V_L, annualised long-run vol, half-life in days. RUMUS: card Core 2: P = alpha + beta; V_L = omega/(1-P); vol_L,annual = sqrt(252 V_L); half-life = ln 0.5/ln P. JAWAB: 1) P < 1 check. 2) V_L. 3) annualise. 4) half-life.

title: GARCH multi-step variance forecast path
frame: DIKETAHUI: params, last e_T, s2_T, horizon h. DITANYAKAN: forecast variances [h] and cumulative h-day variance. RUMUS: card Core 2: s2_{T+1} = omega + alpha e_T^2 + beta s2_T; E[s2_{T+k}] = V_L + P^{k-1}(s2_{T+1} - V_L); h-day variance = sum_k. JAWAB: 1) one-step. 2) path. 3) sum. 4) check monotone convergence to V_L.

title: GARCH term structure of volatility (Hull)
frame: DIKETAHUI: params (daily), current s2_{T+1}, maturities [K] in days. DITANYAKAN: average annualised vol per maturity. RUMUS: Hull: a = ln(1/P); avg variance over T days = V_L + (1 - e^{-aT})/(aT) (s2_{T+1} - V_L) (continuous) or discrete average of path; annual vol = sqrt(252 avg). JAWAB: 1) a. 2) per maturity. 3) annualise variance then sqrt.

title: Conditional variance filter from given GARCH parameters
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], (mu, omega, alpha, beta), initial variance rule. DITANYAKAN: sigma_t series and standardized residuals. RUMUS: card Core 2: e = r - mu; s2_1 per rule (sample var, backcast, or V_L); recursion; z = e/sigma. JAWAB: 1) initialise. 2) recursion. 3) z. 4) check mean(z^2) near 1.
formulas: s2_t = omega + alpha e_{t-1}^2 + beta s2_{t-1}

title: One-step GARCH forecast from last observation
frame: DIKETAHUI: params, last return r_T, last variance s2_T (or series to filter). DITANYAKAN: next-day variance/vol. RUMUS: card Core 2, Conventions: s2_{T+1} = omega + alpha e_T^2 + beta s2_T; 'final conditional vol' in pricing texts usually means this forecast. JAWAB: 1) e_T. 2) forecast. 3) annualise if asked.
formulas: s2_{T+1} = omega + alpha e_T^2 + beta s2_T

title: GJR-GARCH fit and asymmetry
deliverables: summary json: omega, alpha, gamma, beta, persistence, loglik
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T]. DITANYAKAN: GJR parameters, persistence, V_L. RUMUS: card Core 3: s2_t = omega + (alpha + gamma 1{e_{t-1}<0}) e_{t-1}^2 + beta s2_{t-1}; P = alpha + beta + gamma/2; arch_model(..., p=1, o=1, q=1). JAWAB: 1) fit (percent). 2) map back. 3) persistence, V_L. 4) LR test vs GARCH if asked.

title: News impact curve for GARCH and GJR
deliverables: table rows (shock e, s2 next garch, s2 next gjr)
frame: DIKETAHUI: params of each model, grid of shocks e, reference s2 = V_L. DITANYAKAN: next-period variance as a function of e. RUMUS: Engle-Ng 1993: NIC(e) = omega + beta V_L + alpha e^2 (+ gamma e^2 1{e<0}). JAWAB: 1) grid. 2) evaluate. 3) table.
formulas: NIC(e) = omega + beta V_L + (alpha + gamma 1{e<0}) e^2

title: EGARCH(1,1) fit
deliverables: summary json: omega, alpha, gamma, beta, loglik
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T]. DITANYAKAN: EGARCH parameters and LL. RUMUS: Nelson 1991: ln s2_t = omega + alpha (|z_{t-1}| - E|z|) + gamma z_{t-1} + beta ln s2_{t-1}, E|z| = sqrt(2/pi); arch_model(vol='EGARCH', p=1, o=1, q=1). JAWAB: 1) fit. 2) persistence |beta| < 1. 3) long-run ln variance omega/(1-beta).
formulas: - sqrt(2/pi)) + gamma z + beta ln s2_{t-1}

title: GARCH with Student-t innovations
deliverables: summary json: omega, alpha, beta, nu, loglik
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T]. DITANYAKAN: GARCH-t parameters including nu. RUMUS: Bollerslev 1987: standardized t LL per obs = ln Gamma((nu+1)/2) - ln Gamma(nu/2) - 0.5 ln(pi(nu-2) s2_t) - (nu+1)/2 ln(1 + e_t^2/((nu-2) s2_t)); arch_model(dist='t'). JAWAB: 1) fit. 2) nu > 2. 3) compare LL/AIC with normal GARCH.

title: GARCH constant mean versus zero mean
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T]; text specifies mean equation. DITANYAKAN: fit under the stated mean; difference if both asked. RUMUS: card V3: constant mean e = r - mu (mu estimated jointly); zero mean e = r; arch mean='Zero' vs 'Constant'. JAWAB: 1) choose spec from text. 2) fit. 3) report mu if constant.

title: ARCH(q) model fit
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], order q. DITANYAKAN: ARCH parameters. RUMUS: Engle 1982: s2_t = omega + sum_{j=1..q} alpha_j e_{t-j}^2; sum alpha < 1; V_L = omega/(1 - sum alpha); arch_model(vol='ARCH', p=q). JAWAB: 1) fit. 2) V_L. 3) check stationarity.

title: Engle ARCH-LM test for conditional heteroskedasticity
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns or residuals e [T], lags q. DITANYAKAN: LM statistic and p-value. RUMUS: Engle 1982: regress e_t^2 on const and e_{t-1}^2..e_{t-q}^2; LM = (T-q) R^2 ~ chi2(q); statsmodels het_arch(e, nlags=q). JAWAB: 1) demean if stated. 2) auxiliary OLS. 3) LM, p-value. 4) decision.

title: Ljung-Box test on squared returns or standardized residuals
frame: DIKETAHUI: series x [T] (r^2 or z^2), lags m. DITANYAKAN: Q statistics and p-values. RUMUS: Ljung-Box: Q = T(T+2) sum_{k=1..m} rho_k^2/(T-k) ~ chi2(m) (dof reduced by fitted params if stated); statsmodels acorr_ljungbox. JAWAB: 1) autocorrelations. 2) Q. 3) p-values. 4) compare before/after GARCH filtering.

title: GARCH versus EWMA model comparison (LL, AIC, BIC)
deliverables: table rows (model, k, loglik, aic, bic)
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], models list. DITANYAKAN: fit statistics and best model. RUMUS: AIC = 2k - 2LL; BIC = k ln T - 2LL; EWMA has 1 parameter (lambda) or 0 if fixed; same sample and burn-in for all. JAWAB: 1) LL for each on common observations. 2) criteria. 3) argmin.
pitfalls: comparing LL on different samples or units (percent vs decimal)

title: Simulate GARCH(1,1) paths with a seed
frame: DIKETAHUI: params, s2_0 (or V_L), e_0, n_paths, h, seed. DITANYAKAN: simulated returns and variances. RUMUS: card Core 2: z ~ N(0,1) from np.random.default_rng(seed); e_t = sigma_t z_t; s2_{t+1} = omega + alpha e_t^2 + beta s2_t. JAWAB: 1) initialise. 2) vectorised loop over time. 3) outputs. 4) check mean s2 approximately matches forecast formula.

title: GARCH-based one-day VaR forecast
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], c (fit or given params). DITANYAKAN: VaR_{T+1} = z_c sigma_{T+1} - mu. RUMUS: card Core 2 + var-es Core 3. JAWAB: 1) fit/filter. 2) one-step sigma. 3) VaR, ES.

title: DCC two-stage estimation
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns R [T x N]. DITANYAKAN: univariate GARCH params, DCC (a, b), correlation series. RUMUS: card Core 5: stage 1 GARCH per asset -> z; Qbar = Z'Z/T; Q_t recursion; R_t normalised; maximise stage-2 LL; constraints a, b > 0, a+b < 1; toolkit fit_garch11 per column, dcc_correlation(z, a0=0.05, b0=0.93). JAWAB: 1) stage 1. 2) z [T x N]. 3) optimise (a, b). 4) R_t. 5) check unit diagonal.
pitfalls: np.corrcoef for Qbar when Z'Z/T is standard

title: DCC correlation filter from given parameters
frame: DIKETAHUI: standardized residuals Z [T x N], a, b. DITANYAKAN: R_t series (or last R_T). RUMUS: card Core 5, V6(a): Qbar = Z'Z/T, Q_1 = Qbar, recursion, normalise. JAWAB: 1) Qbar. 2) loop. 3) normalise. 4) output pairs.

title: DCC correlation forecast k steps ahead
frame: DIKETAHUI: a, b, Qbar, Q_{T+1}. DITANYAKAN: forecast correlations. RUMUS: card Core 5: Q_{T+k} = Qbar + (a+b)^{k-1}(Q_{T+1} - Qbar); R_{T+k} by normalising (approximation per Engle-Sheppard). JAWAB: 1) Q path. 2) normalise. 3) check convergence to Qbar-implied correlation.

title: Constant conditional correlation (CCC) covariance
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns R [T x N]. DITANYAKAN: CCC correlation and covariance forecast. RUMUS: Bollerslev 1990: univariate GARCH sigma_i,t; R = corr(Z) (constant); H_t = D_t R D_t. JAWAB: 1) stage 1. 2) R from Z. 3) D_{T+1}. 4) H.

title: Conditional covariance forecast and portfolio volatility from DCC
frame: DIKETAHUI: D_{T+1} (vol forecasts) [N], R_{T+1} [N x N], weights w. DITANYAKAN: H_{T+1} and portfolio vol. RUMUS: card Core 5: H = D R D; sigma_p = sqrt(w' H w). JAWAB: 1) D diag. 2) H. 3) sigma_p. 4) annualise if asked.
pitfalls: applying D R D to already correlated simulated rows

title: Daily realised variance from intraday prices
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday prices per day [n_d], sampling rule. DITANYAKAN: RV per day (daily scale). RUMUS: card Core 6: r_i = ln P_i - ln P_{i-1} within the session; RV = sum r_i^2; exclude overnight. JAWAB: 1) sort, dedupe timestamps. 2) session filter. 3) returns per day. 4) RV. 5) check RV > 0.
pitfalls: including overnight return in intraday RV

title: RV at sparse sampling frequency (every f minutes)
frame: DIKETAHUI: 1-minute prices, frequency f. DITANYAKAN: RV at f-minute sampling. RUMUS: card Conventions, V4(a): keep observations with (minute offset from open) mod f == 0 (no forward fill); previous-tick resample only if stated. JAWAB: 1) minute offsets. 2) subset. 3) returns. 4) RV per day.

title: Annualised realised volatility series
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily RV [D]. DITANYAKAN: annualised realised vol. RUMUS: card Core 9: vol_a = sqrt(252 RV_d); average across days: sqrt(252 mean(RV)). JAWAB: 1) per day. 2) aggregate as stated (mean variance, then sqrt).

title: Bipower variation and jump component
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday returns per day [n]. DITANYAKAN: RV, BV, jump = max(RV - BV, 0). RUMUS: card Core 6, V5(a): BV = (pi/2) sum_{i=2..n} |r_i||r_{i-1}|; finite-sample n/(n-1) only if stated. JAWAB: 1) RV. 2) BV. 3) jump. 4) jump share J/RV.

title: Jump test statistic from RV and BV (ratio z)
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday returns per day, significance a. DITANYAKAN: jump z per day and flags. RUMUS: Huang-Tauchen 2005: TQ = n mu_{4/3}^{-3} (n/(n-2)) sum |r_i|^{4/3}|r_{i-1}|^{4/3}|r_{i-2}|^{4/3}, mu_{4/3} = 2^{2/3} Gamma(7/6)/Gamma(1/2); z = ((RV-BV)/RV)/sqrt(((pi/2)^2 + pi - 5)/n max(1, TQ/BV^2)). JAWAB: 1) RV, BV, TQ. 2) z. 3) flag z > norm.ppf(1-a).
formulas: z = ((RV - BV)/RV) / sqrt(theta/n max(1, TQ/BV^2)), theta = (pi/2)^2 + pi - 5

title: Microstructure noise variance estimate
frame: DIKETAHUI: highest-frequency intraday returns per day [n]. DITANYAKAN: noise variance w2. RUMUS: card Core 7: E[RV_n] = IV + 2 n w2 -> w2_hat = RV_n/(2n) at the highest frequency. JAWAB: 1) RV at highest frequency. 2) w2 = RV/(2n). 3) average across days if asked.

title: Bias-corrected realised variance
frame: DIKETAHUI: RV at frequency f with n_f returns, w2 estimate. DITANYAKAN: noise-corrected RV. RUMUS: card Core 7: RV_f,corr = RV_f - 2 n_f w2. JAWAB: 1) w2 from highest frequency. 2) correction at f. 3) floor at zero only if stated.

title: Two-scale realised variance (TSRV)
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday prices per day [n+1], K subgrids. DITANYAKAN: TSRV per day. RUMUS: card Core 7: RV_avg = mean over k of RV on grid k, k+K, ...; nbar = (n-K+1)/K; TSRV = RV_avg - (nbar/n) RV_all. JAWAB: 1) all-tick RV. 2) K subgrid RVs. 3) average. 4) TSRV.

title: Subsampled (averaged) realised variance
frame: DIKETAHUI: 1-minute prices, sparse frequency f. DITANYAKAN: average of f offset-grid RVs. RUMUS: Zhang et al.: RV_sub = (1/f) sum_{k=0..f-1} RV on grid starting at minute k. JAWAB: 1) offset grids. 2) RV each. 3) average.

title: Volatility signature table across sampling frequencies
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday prices, list of frequencies. DITANYAKAN: average RV per frequency. RUMUS: card Invariants: RV rises at high frequency under noise (RV_1min >= RV_30min typically). JAWAB: 1) RV per frequency per day. 2) average across days. 3) table, annualised vol optional.

title: Realised covariance and correlation of two assets
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday prices for two assets on a common grid. DITANYAKAN: realised covariance and correlation per day. RUMUS: Andersen et al.: RCov = sum r1_i r2_i on synchronised grid (previous-tick or common timestamps); RCorr = RCov/sqrt(RV1 RV2). JAWAB: 1) synchronise. 2) returns. 3) sums. 4) ratio.

title: Parkinson high-low volatility
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T x 4] (or H, L). DITANYAKAN: Parkinson vol. RUMUS: card Core 8: var = mean((ln H/L)^2)/(4 ln 2); annualise. JAWAB: 1) logs. 2) mean square range. 3) divide. 4) sqrt, annualise.

title: Garman-Klass volatility
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T x 4]. DITANYAKAN: Garman-Klass vol. RUMUS: card Core 8: var = mean(0.5 (ln H/L)^2 - (2 ln 2 - 1)(ln C/O)^2). JAWAB: 1) per-day terms. 2) mean. 3) sqrt, annualise.

title: Rogers-Satchell volatility (drift robust)
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T x 4]. DITANYAKAN: Rogers-Satchell vol. RUMUS: card Core 8: u = ln H/O, d = ln L/O, c = ln C/O; var = mean(u(u-c) + d(d-c)). JAWAB: 1) per-day terms (>= 0 when H >= max(O,C), L <= min(O,C)). 2) mean. 3) sqrt.

title: Yang-Zhang volatility
deliverables: summary json: v_o, v_c, v_rs, k, sigma_yz
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [n+1 x 4] (previous close needed), window n days. DITANYAKAN: Yang-Zhang vol. RUMUS: card Core 8: o = ln O_t/C_{t-1}; c = ln C_t/O_t; V_o, V_c sample variances (ddof=1); V_RS mean; k = 0.34/(1.34 + (n+1)/(n-1)); var = V_o + k V_c + (1-k) V_RS. JAWAB: 1) align previous close. 2) components. 3) k with n = days. 4) combine, sqrt, annualise.

title: Rolling range-based volatility table versus close-to-close
deliverables: table rows (date, cc, parkinson, gk, rs, yz)
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T x 4], window W. DITANYAKAN: rolling vol per estimator and relative efficiency. RUMUS: card Core 8, Pitfalls: W-day window has W range terms but W-1 close-to-close returns; efficiency = var(cc estimates)/var(range estimates). JAWAB: 1) per-day terms. 2) rolling means (W terms). 3) cc rolling std. 4) annualise. 5) efficiency.

title: Close-to-close historical volatility (rolling and full sample)
frame: DIKETAHUI: close prices [T+1], window W. DITANYAKAN: historical vol. RUMUS: card Core 8-9: std of log returns ddof=1 (mean of squares if zero-mean stated); annualise sqrt(252); toolkit annualized_vol(r, 252). JAWAB: 1) log returns. 2) rolling std. 3) annualise.

title: Volatility of volatility from a conditional-vol series
frame: DIKETAHUI: annualised conditional vol series [T]. DITANYAKAN: vol-of-vol. RUMUS: card Completing: std(ddof=1) of first differences of the annualised vol series; already per-day change, no second rescale unless asked; log-vol variant std(diff(ln sigma)). JAWAB: 1) series. 2) diff. 3) std. 4) annualise only if text says.

title: HAR-RV model (Corsi) for realised variance forecasting
deliverables: summary json: beta0, beta_d, beta_w, beta_m, forecast
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily RV [D]. DITANYAKAN: HAR coefficients and next-day RV forecast. RUMUS: Corsi 2009: RV_{t+1} = b0 + b_d RV_t + b_w mean(RV_{t-4..t}) + b_m mean(RV_{t-21..t}) + e; OLS (toolkit ols, HAC optional). JAWAB: 1) regressors (drop first 21). 2) OLS. 3) forecast from last values.
formulas: RV_{t+1} = b0 + b_d RV_t + b_w RV^w_t + b_m RV^m_t

title: Annualisation conventions by data frequency
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns of a stated frequency and market. DITANYAKAN: annualised vol with correct factor. RUMUS: card Core 9: equities daily 252; crypto 365; weekly 52; monthly 12; scale variance linearly. JAWAB: 1) detect frequency from dates. 2) choose factor. 3) annualise variance, sqrt.

title: Intraday per-minute volatility annualised
frame: DIKETAHUI: 1-minute returns over sessions. DITANYAKAN: per-minute, daily, annual vol. RUMUS: card Core 9: sigma_daily = sigma_min sqrt(390) (regular US session) excluding overnight; annual = sigma_min sqrt(390 * 252). JAWAB: 1) minute std. 2) scale. 3) note overnight gap omitted.

title: Overnight returns combined with intraday RV
frame: DIKETAHUI: intraday prices and previous close. DITANYAKAN: total daily variance estimate. RUMUS: Hansen-Lunde: RV_total = r_on^2 + RV_intraday, or scale RV_intraday by c = sum r_cc^2/sum RV as stated. JAWAB: 1) overnight returns. 2) combine or scale. 3) compare with close-to-close variance.

title: Implied versus realised volatility spread
frame: DIKETAHUI: implied vol series (annualised, percent or decimal), daily returns. DITANYAKAN: realised vol over the matching forward window and the spread. RUMUS: Standard: forward realised vol over next n days sqrt(252/n sum r^2); VRP = IV^2 - RV^2 (variance) or IV - RV (vol), as stated. JAWAB: 1) units to decimal. 2) forward windows aligned. 3) spread series and mean.

title: Volatility forecast evaluation (MSE and QLIKE)
frame: DIKETAHUI: variance forecasts h_t per model, proxy RV_t or r_t^2. DITANYAKAN: average losses per model. RUMUS: Patton 2011: MSE = mean((RV - h)^2); QLIKE = mean(RV/h - ln(RV/h) - 1). JAWAB: 1) align forecasts with targets. 2) losses. 3) rank.

title: Rolling-window GARCH refit and out-of-sample forecasts
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns r [T], window W, refit frequency. DITANYAKAN: one-step forecasts for each out-of-sample day. RUMUS: card Core 2: for each t >= W fit on r[t-W:t] (or reuse params between refits), forecast s2_t; no look-ahead. JAWAB: 1) loop. 2) fit (warm start). 3) forecast. 4) evaluate.
formulas: t-1} from params fitted on r_{t-W..t-1}

title: GARCH parameter unit conversion (percent or annual to daily decimal)
frame: DIKETAHUI: GARCH parameters quoted in percent or annual units. DITANYAKAN: consistent daily decimal parameters.
